mapper.select: SELECT id, base_id, chunk_no, heading_path, policy_name, policy_no, policy_aliases, topic_type, content_text FROM ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE searchable = TRUE AND base_id = #{baseId} AND ( policy_name = #{keyword} OR policy_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR policy_aliases ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR heading_path ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content_text ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN policy_name = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN policy_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN policy_aliases ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN heading_path ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 9 END, CASE topic_type WHEN 'process' THEN 0 WHEN 'condition' THEN 1 WHEN 'benefit' THEN 2 WHEN 'list' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END, chunk_no ASC, id ASC LIMIT 10
